layout_dets.text: ABSTRACT

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Automated detection of curvilinear structures, e.g., blood vessels or nerve fibres, from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: medical and biomedical images is a crucial early step in automatic image interpretation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: associated to the management of many diseases. Precise measurement of the morpho-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: logical changes of these curvilinear organ structures informs clinicians for understand-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the mechanism, diagnosis, and treatment of e.g. cardiovascular, kidney, eye, lung,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and neurological conditions. In this work, we propose a generic and unified convolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neural network for the segmentation of curvilinear structures and illustrate in several

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2D/3D medical imaging modalities. We introduce a new curvilinear structure segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation network (CS²-Net), which includes a self-attention mechanism in the encoder and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder to learn rich hierarchical representations of curvilinear structures. Two types

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of attention modules - spatial attention and channel attention - are utilized to enhance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the inter-class discrimination and intra-class responsiveness, to further integrate local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features with their global dependencies and normalization, adaptively. Furthermore, to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: facilitate the segmentation of curvilinear structures in medical images, we employ a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1×3 and a 3×1 convolutional kernel to capture boundary features. Besides, we extend

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the 2D attention mechanism to 3D to enhance the network's ability to aggregate depth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information across different layers/slices. The proposed curvilinear structure segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation network is thoroughly validated using both 2D and 3D images across six differ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent imaging modalities. Experimental results across nine datasets show the proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method generally outperforms other state-of-the-art algorithms in various metrics.

layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structures are objects with thin, long, elongated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and, sometimes, arborescent shape, and present distinct inten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sity when compared to their neighbouring structures (Bibiloni

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2016). In the biomedical field, many studies (Kim and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Markoulli, 2018a; Rieber et al., 2006) suggest geometrical and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topological changes in numerous anatomical curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures - e.g., retinal blood vessels, cerebral vasculature, lung air-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ways, or nerve fibres - are closely linked to the presence or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: severity of diseases, including, for instance, diabetes, stroke,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hypertension, and keratitis.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Acquiring images of these anatomical curvilinear structures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: has impact in a number of two-dimensional (2D) and three-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional (3D) imaging modalities, such as colour fundus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: imaging, optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fluorescence angiogram (FA), confocal microscopy (CM), mag-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: netic resonance angiography (MRA), computed tomography

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: angiography (CTA), etc. The top row of Fig. 1 demonstrates

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: five examples of different medical image types, which include

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both 2D (Fig. 1(a-d)) and 3D (Fig. 1(e)) images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As one type of curvilinear structure, retinal blood vessels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are an essential component of the retina, and the morphology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: change of their retinal vasculature is closely related to many

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: systemic, metabolic, and haematologic diseases (Annunziata

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2016; Ding et al., 2014). Retinal blood vessels are usually

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: observed in colour fundus images (Franklin and Rajan, 2014)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and OCTA images (de Carlo et al., 2015). Colour fundus imag-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing can exclusively reveal the superficial vascular network. At

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the same time, OCTA is a new, non-invasive imaging technique

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that generates volumetric angiography images, and can visu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alise the radial peripapillary and deep capillary networks that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are not well-distinguished in colour fundus images. Corneal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nerve fibre properties such as branching, density, and tortuosity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are linked to eye and systemic diseases such as herpes, sim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plex keratitis and dry eye diseases (Eladawi et al., 2017; Kim

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Markoulli, 2018a). In vivo corneal confocal microscopy

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (CCM) is a common technique for the imaging and inspection

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of corneal nerve fibres. Early detection of their geometrical and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topological changes often helps to reduce the incidence of vi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion loss and blindness. MRA is an MRI examination of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: human brain vessels (cerebral vasculature), which is vital for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the diagnosis of many serious diseases such as strokes (Liao

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2012). Cerebral small vessel deformation plays an in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dicative role in lacunar strokes and brain haemorrhages and are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a leading cause of cognitive decline and functional loss in el-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: derly patients (Cuadrado-Godia et al., 2018).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In consequence, accurate extraction of these curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures from medical images is often an essential step

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in quantitative image analysis and computer-aided diagnostic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pipelines. The bottom row of Fig. 1 illustrates the manual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: annotations of five types of medical images. However, man-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ual annotation of these curvilinear structures is an exhaustive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time-consuming task for graders, and subject to human error,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and thus impractical in high-throughput analysis settings like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: screening programmes or microscopy (Zhao et al., 2018b). In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: addition, the commercial software available (e.g. ImageJ¹and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: TubeTK²) still rely heavily on manual refinement. This calls

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for fast, accurate, and fully automated curvilinear structure ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: traction methods.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Over the last two decades, we have witnessed the rapid de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: velopment of curvilinear structure detection methods, espe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cially for blood vessel segmentation, as evidenced by general

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reviews of 2D vessel segmentation (Fraz et al., 2012; Zhao

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2018b), and 3D vessel segmentation (Lesage et al., 2009).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Most existing segmentation methods suffer from issues posed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by high anatomical variability across populations, and the vary-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing scales of curvilinear structures within an image. On one

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hand, noise, poor contrast and low resolution exacerbate these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: problems. Standard image segmentation methods often cannot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: robustly detect all the curvilinear structures of interest. On the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: other hand, deep learning-based techniques have yet to be used

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to segment retinal vessels in OCTA and most of them are de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: signed for the segmentation of vessels or fibers from one spe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cific biomedical imaging modality. Moreover, most of them are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designed specifically for 2D images and cannot easily be ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tended to 3D ones. It has proven very challenging to develop

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a single curvilinear structure detection method that works wel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across a variety of medical imaging modalities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we introduce a novel Channel and Spatial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Attention Network (CS²-Net) to extract curvilinear structures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from images in different imaging modalities. Our work was in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spired by Dual Attention Network (DANet) (Fu et al., 2019)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that were designed for the segmentation of natural images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: While medical images contain more unique features, such as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: simpler semantics and unitary patterns, we first construct a net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work backbone based on the encoder-decoder framework, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then introduce a 1 ×3 and a 3×1 convolutional kernel to capture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more boundary feature to assist the segmentation of curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures, rather than only up-sampling the attention features in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the last layer of DANet. Such approach is more attractive to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: researchers and practitioners, since they need not choose a par-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ticular method for each imaging modality and it is more appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cable to various imaging modalities. The proposed method ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tends considerably our previous work (Mou et al., 2019), which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: focused on 2D curvilinear structure segmentation in medical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images only. In this work, we have improved it so that it is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applicable to segment the curvilinear structures from both 2D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and 3D imaging modalities. We have also expanded our data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pool for evaluation from three biomedical imaging modalities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to six with a total of nine different datasets. Overall, this work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: makes the following contributions:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) A new curvilinear structure segmentation network is pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: posed based on dual self-attention modules, which can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: deal with both 2D and 3D imaging modalities in an uni-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fied manner;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2) Two self-attention mechanisms are employed in the chan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nel and spatial spaces to generate attention-aware expres-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sive features. They can enhance the network to capture

layout_dets.text: 2. Related Works

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. 2D Curvilinear Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As vessels, airways or fibres in 2D medical images are curvi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linear structures distributed across different orientations and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scales, various filtering methods have been proposed, includ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing Hessian matrix-based filters (Frangi et al., 1998a), matched

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: filters (Zhao et al., 2017b), multi-oriented filters (Soares et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2006; Zhang et al., 2017), symmetry filter (Zhao et al., 2018b),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and tensor-based filter (Cetin and Unal, 2015), active contours-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based methods (Shang et al., 2011; Al-Diri et al., 2009) and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: minimal geodesic paths-based approaches (Chen et al., 2019).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: These filtering-based methods aim to suppress non-vascular or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: non-fiber structures and imaging noise, and enhance the curvi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linear structures, thereby benefiting the subsequent segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion problem. For instances, (Zhao et al., 2015, 2018a) pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: posed infinite perimeter active contour model with hybrid re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gion information and a weighted symmetry filter to detect ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sels. (Zhang et al., 2016) designed multi-scale rotation invari-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ant filters for retinal vessel and corneal nerve fibre segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based on a locally adaptive framework in the position and orien-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation spaces. This framework is adaptive to the local changes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of curvilinear structures and can deal with typically difficult

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cases. (Soares et al., 2006) used a multi-scale Gabor transform

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to extract texture features of vessels for more accurate vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detection. There are also several filter-based vessel segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation methods, including Hessian matrix-based filters (Frangi

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 1998a; Zhang et al., 2016), tensor-based filters (Cetin and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Unal, 2015) and symmetry filters (Zhao et al., 2018b). These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approaches aim to remove undesired intensity variations in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images, and suppress background structures and imaging noise,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thereby facilitating the subsequent segmentation task. However

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these filter-based methods usually rely heavily on manual pa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rameter adjustment during implementation, and are designed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mainly for a specific imaging modality, which may not be ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fective when applied to other image types.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recently, deep learning-based methods have made signif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: icant progress in computer vision. These include classifica-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion networks, e.g., ResNet (He et al., 2016) and Inception se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ries networks (Szegedy et al., 2015; Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Szegedy et al., 2016, 2017); object detection networks, e.g.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Faster-RCNN (Ren et al., 2015) and R-FCN (Dai et al., 2016);

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation networks, e.g., SegNet (Badrinarayanan et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2017), PSPNet (Zhao et al., 2017a); and networks designed for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: medical image segmentation, e.g., U-Net (Ronneberger et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2015) and CE-Net (Gu et al., 2019). These deep learning based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods have been modified and applied for blood vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation (Fu et al., 2016; Alom et al., 2018) and nerve fibre

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tracing in colour fundus and CCM images (Colonna et al., 2018;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Williams et al., 2020) , respectively. (Maninis et al., 2016) pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: posed a multi-task structure for both vessel detection and optic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: disc segmentation. (Liskowski and Krawiec, 2016) introduced

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a retinal vessel segmentation method based on a convolutional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: L. Mou et al. /Medical Image Analysis (2020)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neural network (CNN), and (Fu et al., 2016) further applied the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CNN along with conditional random fields for the detection of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: retinal vessels. (Alom et al., 2018) embedded a recurrent neural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network into the U-shaped network (R2U-Net) for the segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation of vessels. (Wang and Chung, 2019) proposed a novel de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tector, named Oriented Cylinder Flux (OCF), for the detection

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of blood vessel structures. (Wang et al., 2019a) proposed a new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure segmentation method using context-aware

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and spatio-recurrent networks. Instead of directly segmenting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the entire image or densely segmenting fixed-size local patches,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it uses a learning strategy to sample the target image with differ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent proportions repeatedly. More details on recent vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation works can be found in (Shin et al., 2019; Jin et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2019; Wang et al., 2019c). (Colonna et al., 2018) proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a deep neural network based on U-Net (Ronneberger et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2015) for corneal fibre tracing in CCM images. (Hosseinaee

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2019) developed an automated method for the segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion of corneal nerves on en face UHR-OCT images obtained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from healthy human subjects. (Kim and Markoulli, 2018b) and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Oakley et al., 2019) systematically summarized the unsuper-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vised and supervised methods for corneal nerve segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and analysed the role of corneal neuromorphological features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in disease diagnosis. (Eladawi et al., 2017) proposed a joint

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Markov-Gibbs random field (MGRF) model to segment blood

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessels based on different retinal maps from OCTA scans. (Díaz

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2019) developed an automatic system that identifies and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: precisely segments the foveal avascular zone (FAZ). (Heisler

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2019) also proposed a novel automated deep learning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method to segment and quantify retinal images from prototype

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: OCTA machines with larger fields of view. For more automated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vascular segmentation and fibre tracing methods, please refer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the review by (Fraz et al., 2012). Although these methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have achieved promising segmentation results, most of them

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concentrate on the segmentation of curvilinear structure for sin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gle imaging modality. Besides, most of them are hard to be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extended for the curvilinear structure segmentation in 3D vol-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: umes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2. 3D Curvilinear Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Three-dimensional volumes contain richer features with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: depth information not available in 2D slices/images. Three-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional vascular segmentation is an essential prior step in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the characterization of cerebral aneurysms, which has proven

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: useful for the pre-treatment planning of Guglielmi separable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coils (GDC) (Wilson, 1998). With developing imaging de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vices, more computer vision methods have been developed to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: deal with 3D data for biomedical data analysis. Most methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perform better on this volumetric data compared to 2D image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: counterpart, especially in medical imaging. (Zhao et al., 2018b)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed a weighted symmetry filter for automatic 2D vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enhancement and segmentation, and further extended it to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3D case for vascular segmentation. (Çiçek et al., 2016) ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tended U-Net to 3D U-Net with a weighted cross entropy loss to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perform Xenopus kidney segmentation, which has been proven

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an effective method for the segmentation of tubular structural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: organs under sparse annotations. (Gibson et al., 2018) used

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a dense V-Net (Milletari et al., 2016) to segment multiple 3D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tubular organs. (Chung and Noble, 1999) adopted a Rician

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distribution to segment 3D brain vasculatures in order to ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tract cerebral aneurysm features. (Tetteh et al., 2018) proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DeepVesselNet to segment vessels, detect vessel centerlines and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bifurcate 3D angiographic volumes. (Liao et al., 2012) rec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ommended to segment human brain vessels using fast match-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing with an anisotropic orientation being a priori. Recently,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Zhang et al., 2019) proposed a novel method for 3D retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: OCTA microvascular segmentation and surface reconstruction.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Intrinsic shape analysis was performed to extract useful surface-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based 3D geometric and topological biomarkers. (Wang et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2019b) proposed a teacher-student learning framework for fast

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neuron segmentation, where the segmentation inference is per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formed using a light-weighted student network which benefits

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from knowledge distillation by a teacher network with a higher

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: capacity. (Zhao et al., 2019) proposed to perform 3D vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation by utilizing a deep feature regression (DFR) method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based on a convolutional regression network (CRN) and a sta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble point clustering mechanism. (Poulain et al., 2019) proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a new approach by combining the information of a tree-spline

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with a registration algorithm to perform 3D coronary vessel tree

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tracking. (Sanchesa et al., 2019) proposed a Uception network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based on Inception modules and the U-Net-like architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to segment cerebrovascular in MRA images. However, many

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modules that rely heavily on GPU resources are used in Ucep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion, which makes the method require considerable GPU mem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ory resources during training and inference stages.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Like the previous 2D segmentation methods, many filter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based 3D tubular structure segmentation methods rely heavily

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on manual tuning. Some methods based on learning strate-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gies ignore the tubular structure by designing particular network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modules, which plays a vital role in their accurate segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Proposed Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Network Architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The proposed CS²-Net is designed for curvilinear structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation of both 2D and 3D medical images. It consists

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of three modules: the encoder module, the channel and spatial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention module (CSAM), and the decoder module. Fig. 2 and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 3 illustrate the architectures for 2D and 3D images, respec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tively. The encoder module is used to extract the features of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: input data. Then, these features are fed into two parallel atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion blocks - the channel attention block (CAB) and a spatial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention block (SAB) - to generate channel-spatial attention-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aware expressive features. The SAB selectively aggregates the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features in each spatial location through the weighted features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in all spatial locations, which allows the model to capture the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: long-range dependency of the features, and similar features will

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be related to each other regardless of their distance. Meanwhile,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the CAB makes sure that the full space is used to represent and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: normalize and thus enhance the contrast of the features in dif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ferent channels, allowing the model to be assembled with im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proved discrimination capabilities. Finally, the decoder module

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is employed to reconstruct curvilinear features and produce the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation result.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.2. 2D Attention Network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Several recent works have shown that the local feature repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations produced by traditional fully convolutional networks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (FCNs) may lead to object misclassification (Zhao et al., 2017a;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Peng et al., 2017). The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder, 2D CASM and 2D decoder, reduces this limitation and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segment curvilinear structures in 2D images more effectively.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: malization and 2D deconvolutional layers in all the modules.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Their working principles are explained as follows.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.2.1. 2D Spatial Attention Module

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To model rich contextual dependencies over local feature rep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resentations, the first step is to generate a spatial attention ma-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trix, which models spatial relationships between the features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of any two pixels. Tree-like structures are always distributed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: throughout the biomedical images. Following (Fu et al., 2019),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we modify the SAB to encode a broader range of contextual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information about local features, and increase their representa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: More importantly, compared with many complex natural im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: image and resampling the original one as in (Fu et al., 2019).

layout_dets.text: datasets, and two private (OCTA and OCT RPE) datasets for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.2. Experimental Setup

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: -Net was implemented in the PyTorch li-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: brary with a dual NVIDIA GPU (GeForce GTX Titan Xp). We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: use adaptive moment estimation (Adam) as the overall opti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mizer. The initial learning rate is set to 0.0001 and we use a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: weight decay of 0.0005 with a poly learning rate policy, where

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the learning rate is multiplied by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with a power

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of 0.9 and a maximum number of epochs of 100. Due to the lim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ited amount of data, data augmentation is used to improve the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance, which includes random cropping (with a size of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 384 × 384), contrast enhancement, random rotation (from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ), random flipping, and mirror flipping about the image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: centre in the training phase. We do not perform augmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the test set. In this paper, we set the batch size to 8 for all the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets and the proposed method is trained on each imaging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modality separately.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To facilitate the observation and objective evaluation of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed method, the following metrics are adopted, accuracy

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (ACC), sensitivity (SE), specificity (SP), and Area under the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ROC curve (AUC):

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: where TP, FN, TN, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: denote true positive, false nega-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive, true negative and false positive, respectively. Area under

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the ROC curve (AUC) reflects the trade-off between sensitiv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity and specificity, and thus evaluates the quality of our vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation results more reliably. In addition, we compute

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the p-values of all the evaluation metrics between the proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method and the compared methods on each dataset for statisti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal analysis, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is considered statistically significant.

layout_dets.text: 4.3. Results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.3.1. Vessel Segmentation in Color Fundus Image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To demonstrate the curvilinear structure segmentation per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formance of the proposed method, we first evaluate it on three

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: public datasets (DRIVE, STARE and IOSTAR) that are com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mon and highly recognized in medical imaging. Seven state-of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the-art methods were selected for comparison, which include

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two conventional filtering-based vessel methods (Combination

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of Shifted Filter Responses (COSFIRE) (Azzopardi et al., 2015)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Weighted Symmetry Filter (WSF) (Zhao et al., 2018b)),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two specially designed deep learning-based vessel methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (DeepVessel (Fu et al., 2016) and Context Encoder Network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (CE-Net) (Gu et al., 2019)), and three state-of-the-art networks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (U-Net (Ronneberger et al., 2015), Recurrent Residual U-Net

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (R2U-Net) (Alom et al., 2018), and Dual Attention Network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (DANet) (Fu et al., 2019)). Note, the results of BCOSFIRE,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: WSF, and Deep Vessel were quoted from their papers for con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: venience.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the retinal fundus datasets, where our proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: -Net out-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performs all the competing methods on ACC and AUC scores.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Thus, it can be confirmed that the spatial and channel attention

layout_dets.text: low contrast regions. To better observe the significance of the

layout_dets.text: proposed method and comparison methods in segmenting reti-

layout_dets.text: 4.3.3. Corneal Nerve Fiber Tracing in the CORN-1 Images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We further evaluate the performance of our

layout_dets.text: have published. For validation, we compute the sensitivity and

layout_dets.text: 6. Discussions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: utilizes spatial and channel atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion modules to capture the structural information of the tree-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: like objects in the horizontal and vertical directions, respec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tively. In this work, we carefully designed a network focusing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the extraction of the curvilinear structures in medical im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ages. Compared with natural images, medical imagery contains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unique features, such as simpler semantics and unitary patterns.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Therefore, we first construct a network backbone based on the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder-decoder framework. More importantly, we introduce a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convolutional kernel to capture more bound-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ary features to assist the segmentation of curvilinear structures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DANet (Fu et al., 2019) uses a pre-trained model to extract fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures, and up-samples the attention features in the last layer of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model, and this is the architectural difference between the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed method and DANet. Second, we introduce batch nor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: malization and ReLU activations after the convolutional layers

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the spatial attention module to ensure that the mean and vari-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ance of the input distribution are fixed within a specific range,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reducing the internal covariate shift in the network, and mitigat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the gradient disappearance to a certain extent. Third, since

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3D volume contains rich depth information not included in 2D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: medical images, many critical lesions can be better observed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through different layers in the 3D volume. Here, we extend the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2D attention mechanism to 3D to enhance the network's abil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity to aggregate depth information across different image slices.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Therefore, we design a 3D volume segmentation network, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convolution kernels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the 3D attention module with batch normalization and ReLU

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: activetions. This network is thus more suitable for 3D medi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal data analysis. Besides, we evaluate the proposed method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on a variety of medical datasets in different modalities, and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: evaluation results also confirmed that our proposed method is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 7. Conclusion and Future Works

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structure segmentation is a fundamental step in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: automated diagnosis of many diseases, and it remains a chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenging medical image analysis problem despite considerable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: research efforts. In this paper, we developed a new curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation network, named

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: -Net, which applies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to both 2D images and 3D volumes. Our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: -Net improves the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inter-class discrimination and intra-class aggregation abilities,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by applying a self-attention mechanism to high-level features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the channel and spatial dimensions (Fu et al., 2019). The ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perimental results over 9 datasets across 6 imaging modalities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: L. Mou et al. /Medical Image Analysis (2020)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have demonstrated that the proposed method can improve seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation results. Our results confirm its great potential as a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: powerful image analysis method application in computer-aided

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diagnosis from medical imaging, and in automated biological

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image interpretation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Over the past few years there has been an increasing number

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of AI models proposed and published. The lack of evaluation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of their usefulness across different images in different applica-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions shows down their adoption in real applications. Our work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: makes a first step towards more extensive evaluation of AI mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els to demonstrate their effectiveness and applicability across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: several applications.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Although this paper highlights the potential and applicabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity of our proposed CS²-Net method for general curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation, there remain several areas of improve-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment and future research. Diseased cells with similar fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures to curvilinear structures can lead our model to over seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment these curvilinear structures. Additional information could

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: help addressing this limitation like, for instance, the inclu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion of local neighbourhood and continuity constraints. Three-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional volumetric segmentation consumes considerable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: GPU resources, which increases the computational demands of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model training. The architecture could potentially be simplified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: without compromising accuracy, and hence reducing the com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plexity of the proposed method.
